public_rationale: There is evidence of a narrower episode: Altman acknowledged losses on ChatGPT Pro in January 2025. That does not establish heavy subsidies across both labs throughout the claimed history. Anthropic's filing shows a positive company-wide difference between 2025 revenue and cost of revenue, but mixes subscription and consumption-based business. Neither source supplies the matching historical subscription economics needed to settle the claim.
limitations: The OpenAI evidence is an executive statement reported by a news outlet, without a financial breakdown.
The Anthropic filing measures a broader business and a different accounting basis from the contextual estimates.
The claim leaves its starting date and subsidy threshold unspecified.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI labs have been heavily subsidizing their own products all along.

statement.excerpt: AI labs have, this entire time, been massively subsidizing their own products.
statement.document_title: The Subprime AI Crisis Is Here

our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion identifies OpenAI and Anthropic and focuses on their own subscriptions.
The ordinary reading is that subscription receipts have persistently fallen materially below attributable delivery costs, rather than merely below the retail API value of maximum usage.
Corporate losses, research spending and losses on selected heavy users do not by themselves establish subscription-wide subsidies.
This entire time describes a historical period ending with the post. Its beginning is unspecified and is left open rather than assigned an invented date.
The contextual financial basis is an estimate: Zitron relies on reported analyses of usage and compute spending.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable historical subscription revenue and attributable delivery-cost records show substantial, persistent shortfalls across the labs and products covered.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable subscription-level records show sustained positive delivery margins inconsistent with the asserted broad and persistent subsidy.

evidence.explanation: The filing reports 2025 company-wide revenue of $4,585 million and cost of revenue of $2,773 million, implying a positive difference.
